institution: Department of AI & Data Science, RMK Engineering College
milestone: Phase 5 Step 6.1 — Independent StateGraph Orchestration, Verification Governance & Human Approval Security Audit
verdict_justification: Independent audit confirms that Phase 5 Step 6 multi-agent StateGraph orchestration in backend/app/agents/graph.py strictly enforces all architectural, governance, and security invariants. Worker agents (ANOMALY_DETECTION, ROOT_CAUSE_ANALYSIS) are completely barred from mutating workflow_status, verification_decisions, or human_approval via reducer-level permissions. Hypotheses cannot self-assert VERIFIED status, and the Verification Governance node correctly renders decision records with INSUFFICIENT_DATA and state status UNVERIFIED, preventing autonomous closure. The Human Approval Gate halts graph traversal on PENDING at END, maintaining strict isolation from the Phase 4 ticket-dispatch tool (create_maintenance_ticket), which remains behind an external HMAC approval token boundary. Acyclic routing guards prevent infinite re-execution loops. All 40 orchestration tests and the entire 185-test Phase 5 regression suite pass with a 100% pass rate (0 failures, 0 errors). Zero database mutations and zero Git modifications occurred.

audit_a_verification_authority.findings: Authority is strictly separated from worker execution. CandidateRootCause schema prohibits self-assertion of VERIFIED status. Verification decisions are emitted under Supervisor authority with status INSUFFICIENT_DATA and method UNVERIFIED, preserving candidate hypotheses as UNVERIFIED. Multi-source diversity calculation is keyed on EvidenceSourceType set cardinality; multiple citations from one manual document count as 1 source, and multiple sensor channels count as 1 source. Synthetic evidence is capped at 0.70 and cannot satisfy independent verification.

audit_b_human_approval_and_resumption.findings: Pending approval halts execution turn at END in WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL. State is preserved. Resumption continues via Supervisor evaluation of current_stage == HUMAN_APPROVAL_GATE. Checkpointer is optional and defaults to None, meaning default execution is in-memory and stateful resumption requires caller state re-supply or explicit Checkpointer injection. Approver identity rejects AI agent names at Pydantic level; full cryptographic verification is enforced at the Phase 4 MCP boundary.

audit_c_workflow_status_authority.findings: Worker nodes attempting to write workflow_status, human_approval, or verification_decisions raise PermissionError in validate_agent_state_update. Terminal workflow states (COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED) cannot be restarted and route directly to END. WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL is a valid WorkflowStatus enum. Exceptions in supervisor or workers safely transition workflow to FAILED without unhandled process termination. Failed inference is never represented as normal equipment.

audit_d_duplicate_execution_and_idempote.findings: Within a single graph execution pass, acyclic edges and state guards guarantee bounded execution. However, external invocations with identical initial states re-query SQLite and ChromaDB because no idempotency cache exists in graph.py. Database-level proposal deduplication and ticket lock semantics are managed in Phase 4 rather than LangGraph state.

audit_e_ticket_creation_security.findings: create_maintenance_ticket tool is completely absent from all graph nodes and worker agents. Neither Supervisor nor workers can mint HMAC approval tokens. Proposal staging and ticket dispatch remain separate. Note: Phase 4 Step 6.1 production blocker (ticket creation committed before consumed token insertion in tools.py:906-931) remains unresolved in Phase 4 MCP code, but does not compromise Phase 5 StateGraph integrity.

audit_f_real_integration_test_quality.findings: All 40 tests in test_agent_graph.py verified. Classification: 3 pure unit tests, 25 mock-based graph integration tests, 8 security regression tests, 2 real integration tests (test_37 loads real Isolation Forest, Scaler, and Kernel SHAP; test_38 executes real SQLite queries and .venv-rag subprocess Chroma retrieval), 1 serialization test, 1 database read-only invariant test. Zero persistent data mutation occurred.

audit_g_graph_topology_and_failure_routi.findings: Graph topology verified: START -> supervisor -> (anomaly_detection / rca / human_approval_gate / END). Normal telemetry bypasses RCA cleanly. Anomaly failure routes to FAILED. Degraded or zero-hypothesis RCA routes to human_approval_gate without infinite recursion. Acyclic guards in route_from_supervisor intercept repeated routing.

audit_h_supervisor_regression.findings: Step 6 modification in supervisor.py added an explicit rca_executed check for empty candidate hypotheses routing to ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN_GATE. All original Supervisor policies, confidence thresholds, and terminal state protections remain intact. All 28 tests in test_supervisor_agent.py pass with zero regressions.

findings_classification.description: Stateless default execution: run_manumind_workflow does not configure a persistent LangGraph checkpointer by default, returning the paused state dictionary on PENDING. Resumption requires the caller to manage state persistence or inject an explicit checkpointer with thread_id.
findings_classification.remediation: Document checkpointer integration requirements for production deployment in Phase 5 Step 7 / Phase 6.

findings_classification.description: Non-atomic ticket creation in Phase 4 MCP server: create_ticket_with_approval_gate commits ticket to SQLite before consumed token is inserted in handle_create_maintenance_ticket. While isolated from Phase 5 graph, this remains a production blocker for Phase 4.
findings_classification.remediation: Unify ticket creation, consumed token insertion, and proposal status update into a single database transaction in Phase 6 hardening.

findings_classification.description: Lack of external query caching: Repeated external graph invocations with the same input state re-execute ML inference and RAG subprocess retrieval.
findings_classification.remediation: Introduce an idempotency key and caching layer at the API / task-worker entry point in Phase 6.

conditions_for_step7: Preserve all worker forbidden channel boundaries and acyclic routing guards.
Maintain the Human Approval Gate halting behavior for PENDING proposals.
Do not expose create_maintenance_ticket tool to LangGraph agent nodes.
Retain candidate hypothesis UNVERIFIED status until authorized external human verification.
